AgentResponse.description:
The only thing the API returns — never AgentState directly.
Internal fields (raw tool arguments, full result payloads,
conversation_context) stay server-side; this is the trimmed,
user-facing contract.
AgentResponse.title: AgentResponse

grading_notice.default: Multiple choice is graded by exact match. Short answers and coding answers are graded against a keyword/text rubric, not a semantic judgement. Submitted code is never executed, so no tests, correctness, security or code-quality analysis is performed.
grading_notice.title: Grading Notice

note.default: Repository evidence is separate from your recorded skill levels. It never changes UserSkill and is not verified proficiency.
note.title: Note

GithubEvidenceRef.description: Compact form embedded in the application readiness report.
GithubEvidenceRef.title: GithubEvidenceRef

SkillEvidence.description:
One skill claim, always traceable to the text that justified it.
`normalized_skill` is the catalog slug if a match was found — never
populated with a guess; an unmatched skill instead shows up in
ResumeAnalysis.unmatched_skills, never silently dropped or invented
into the catalog.
SkillEvidence.title: SkillEvidence

SkillImportance.description:
Deterministic criticality of a JD-required skill (Phase 7).
Distinct from ImportanceLevel, which is the requirement *type*.
SkillImportance.title: SkillImportance

info.description: PathForge AI backend: agent + MCP client, RAG, resume analysis, job description skill-gap analysis, roadmap generation, adaptive re-planning, job application tracking and GitHub repository skill evidence, assessments with persistent evidence, and a contextual mentor. Protected by bearer-token authentication (see /api/auth/login).
info.title: PathForge AI API

post.description:
Minimal endpoint to exercise the orchestrator end to end. Requires authentication; the request's ``user_id`` is
optional and, when present, must be the authenticated user (it only attributes ``MCPToolLog`` rows).

get.description:
Liveness/readiness probe. Confirms the API is up, the configured
database is reachable, and reports which mode (demo vs live) the
backend is running in — useful once MCP tool clients and LLM
providers start branching on DEMO_MODE in later phases.

schema.title: Response Health Check Api Health Get

get.description:

(the API still serves auth, roadmaps, applications etc. without them).
